      id: "icon",
      children: "Icon"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "설치",
      children: "설치"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "language-bash",
        children: "yarn add @wanteddev/wds-icon\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "목록",
      children: "목록"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsx(_components.li, {

      }), "\n"]

      hideCode: true,
      code: `import { FlexBox, Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger, useToast, TextInput, TextInputContent } from '@wanteddev/wds';
import * as Icons from '@wanteddev/wds-icon';
import copy from 'copy-to-clipboard';
import { useState, startTransition, useMemo } from 'react';

const Demo = () => {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [value, setValue] = useState('');

  const icons = useMemo(() => {
    if (value) {
      return Object.entries(Icons).filter(([name]) => name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(value.toLocaleLowerCase()));
    }

    return Object.entries(Icons);
  }, [value]);

  const handleClick = (value) => () => {
    const success = copy(value);

    if (success) {
      toast({
        variant: 'success',
        content: value + ' 클립보드에 복사 했습니다.',
      });
    }
  }

  return (
    <FlexBox flexDirection="column" gap="24px">
      <TextInput
        sx={{ alignSelf: 'end' }}
        width="300px"
        rightContent={(
          <TextInputContent variant="icon">
            <Icons.IconSearch />
          </TextInputContent>
        )}
        placeholder="아이콘명을 검색하세요."
        value={value}
        onChange={e => {
          startTransition(() => setValue(e.target.value))
        }}
      />

      <FlexBox flexWrap="wrap" gap="12px" justifyContent="center">
        {icons.map(([name, Component]) => (
          <Tooltip mode="hover" key={name} enterDelay={10} leaveDelay={10}>
            <TooltipTrigger>
              <FlexBox
                as="button"
                sx={theme => ({ 
                  backgroundColor: theme.palette.background.elevated.alternative,
                  borderRadius: '4px',
                  fontSize: '32px',
                  height: '48px',
                  width: '48px',
                  color: theme.palette.label.normal,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                })}
                alignItems="center"
                justifyContent="center"
                name={name}
                onClick={handleClick(name)}
              >
                <Component />

                <span style={{ fontSize: '0px' }}>{name}</span>
              </FlexBox>
            </TooltipTrigger>
            <TooltipContent
              position="bottom-center"
            >
              {name}
            </TooltipContent>
          </Tooltip>
        ))}
      </FlexBox>
    </FlexBox>
  )
}

export default Demo;`
    })]
  });
}

}

  default: MDXContent
